title: Illustrative Clemson airborne microplastic transport and deposition
status: Illustrative theoretical sensitivity study; no measured emission inventory or observed AMP validation

source.interpretation: Hypothetical 100 m by 100 m near-ground area source, centered on the domain; emissions normalized to 1 g/s total, not an estimate of a real source

particle_assumptions.shape: Equivalent spherical surrogates; shape sensitivity is a separate settling calculation, not resolved fiber morphology in AERMOD
particle_assumptions.rate_basis: Equal emitted mass across cases; particle-number emissions differ with size and density
particle_assumptions.diameter_note: Numerical equivalent-sphere diameter supplied to the density-dependent particle formula in AERMOD26135; do not additionally density-convert the input diameter

meteorology.surface_characteristics_status: Illustrative assumptions, not an AERSURFACE site characterization
meteorology.wind_processing: AERMINUTE26135 observed KCEU one-minute ASOS winds; hourly surface observations retained as supported AERMET fallback
meteorology.sonic_anemometer_status: ASSUMED IFW sonic status effective 2023-01-01 for processing; not a verified installation date; see aerminute/input_provenance.json

scientific_scope.modeled: Local steady-state hourly dispersion, dry and wet deposition/depletion over a 20 km domain
not_modeled: Long-range transport beyond the receptor domain
Explicit fiber orientation or nonspherical aerodynamics
Measured environmental AMP concentrations or emissions
scientific_scope.interpretation: Compare particle cases under identical observed weather; annual means are not instantaneous plume snapshots
